body:
## Short summary of the bug

Composer Widget Does not Delete data in the promo or scratch DOM before new data is loaded.

## Description

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Run Composer Widget
2. Watch data get loaded twice in the Promo/Scratch SVGs, once on loading and once on loading the tree

### Expected Behavior
Composer deletes the items in DOM before loading the new data for Promo and Scratch.

### Actual Behavior
Composer writes the same data multiple times.

## Background (local scenario)

Examining the code in the `src/js` directory, the widget loads data through both `init()` and a refresh function, which must be run on changing of a radio button, or on the return data from an RMB menu event.

## Problem

The `src/js/panel.tree.js` file has a `clearData()` function that clears the data in the tree view SVG's DOM before the new data is loaded. The force graphs in `src/js/panel.promo.js` and `src/js/panel.scratch.js` do not have a `clearData()` function that removes the current DOM data before loading the new data. Thus, when refresh is run, the new data loads on top of the old data.

## Solution

Add `clearData()` (or equivalent DOM clearing) to the Promo and Scratch panels so that existing force-graph SVG elements (nodes, links, edge paths, edge labels) are removed before new data is rendered. Ensure this clear runs before loading new data (e.g. at the start of `showGraph()` or from `widget.loadData()` before calling panel showGraph). Restart the simulation after clearing so the force graph runs with the new data.

## Source

- **Source issue**: https://github.com/os-threat/os-threat-alpha-1-program/issues/91
title: Composer Widget Does not Delete data in the promo or scratch DOM before new data is loaded
